summaries.text: Corporate Assets Should be used to Hire Act - Amends the Internal Revenue Code to impose on domestic corporations in taxable years beginning in 2011 or 2012 an additional 40% tax on the excess of their retained earnings over their average retained earnings for the preceding 3 taxable years.  Exempts certain corporations from such tax, including corporations with retained earnings of less than $5 million in a taxable year.
